Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

- (iii) The different modes available to a pensioner for submission of Annual Life Certificate, manually or digitally, are summarized
- below-
- (a) Can be recorded by Pension Disbursing Banks (PDBs), if the pensioner physically appears before PDA.
- (b) When the pensioner submits the form signed by any 'designated official' specified for signing the Life Certificate, personal appearance will not be required.
- (c) Pensioners can submit online from home through 'Jeevan
- Pramaan Portal'.
